notes.title: Improved Multiplayer Steam Beta & Patch v1.2.204
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Riders,[/h2][p][/p][p]We have released version 1.2.204 today, which mainly improves the backup system for save files and a few other smaller bug fixes, as well as trail changes. You can have a look at the full change log below.  [/p][p]We also worked a lot on netcode improvements over the last few months and we would like to invite you all to a [b]Beta Test on Monday the 22nd of September[/b]. The test will start at 12pm CEST on a Steam beta branch (Instructions how to join will follow on Monday) and will be live for 24 hours. The improved network code should greatly reduce lag and rollbacks but we would like to get more feedback from the community before we can put it live for everyone. This is also a rare chance to play against the Megagon team as most of us will participate in the test as well. [/p][p][/p][p]We would really appreciate it if you could take some time next week to join the test![/p][p][/p][p]All the best,[/p][p]  Your Megagons[/p][p][/p][h1]PATCH LOG 1.204
[/h1][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Critical: [/b]The game now saves multiple backup save files and creates a new one at the beginning of each day. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical:[/b] If the main save file can’t be loaded players are now notified and can decide to try again or load the backup save file. If both fails players can choose to reset the game to a clean save or quit the game. Please let us know in our Discord or via [url="https://support@megagonindustries.com"]support@megagonindustries.com[/url] if your backup save game also doesn’t work. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Major:[/b] Fixed a bug that players could return to a resting spot after crashing inside it. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor: [/b]Fixed an edge case in which the Recover-UI wasn’t displayed correctly in team mode. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor: [/b]Fixed bug that the free ride achievement was triggered too early. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor: [/b]Fixed game stuck on loading screen when a 2nd monitor wasn’t turned on. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor: [/b]Fixed wrong sound played at the start of trick mode. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Major (Xbox Only): [/b]Fixed that the How To Play Screen for the team mode was missing on Xbox.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor (Xbox Only):[/b] Fixed a bug that the PC input settings were available on console.  [/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Speedrunning Critical:[/b] Adjusted some ramps that were added in the Freestylers level updates that may interfere with optimal racing lines that existed previous to the update.[/p][list][*][p][b]Eisige Allee:[/b] Updated a stone in front of a ramp in section 2 of the black slope[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weinender Wald:[/b] Adjusted two ramps in Section 2 (blue slope) that may make the optimal racing line harder[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grimmiger Hang: [/b]Removed one ramp in Section 5 (blue slope) that obstructs the most optimal shortcut[/p][/*][*][p][b]Donggu: [/b]Adjusted two ramps in Section 3 that blocked two different shortcut options[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: FREESTYLERS UPDATE - New Trick & Free Ride Mode & much more!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey Riders![/h3][p][/p][p]The Freestylers Update is finally here, adding two new modes to the game! A completely new Trick Mode and also the beloved Free Ride Mode from Lonely Mountains: Downhill is making its comeback![/p][previewyoutube="AYmyfE9Y_2A;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In [b]Trick Mode, [/b]players compete for style over speed, completing over 100 new challenges in a ground-up reimagining of the Snow Riders experience. The mode unlocks at level 20. [/p][previewyoutube="iWIlTFsTgpM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Free Ride Mode[/b] was a feature in our last game Lonely Mountains: Downhill, now finally in Snow Riders! The ultimate challenge to all speedrunners, Free Ride removes all checkpoints, allowing players to carve their own ultrafast route down the mountain. You need to reach level 35 to unlock this mode. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="umGNvo-KKBM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Both modes come with full leaderboard support and new achievements, and also allow you to reach the highest player level without competing in multiplayer matches. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Kivp_iJ4tpI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The Freestylers Update also comes with a wide range of new accessibility features, including auto-brake, auto-accelerate, toggling buttons instead of holding them, and button mapping.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="cdTnT-49LcA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We would be very grateful to hear your feedback on the new additions, especially the difficulty of the Trick Mode challenges. [/p][p]
[b]You can find the full patch log down below.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]We also took the opportunity to update our roadmap for this year. The biggest change is that the PS5 version has moved from Summer to Autumn. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149182/ca7159dd968fcde9a6281df8d06f7c6a1ade2d94.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you so much everyone for supporting the game! [/p][p]Happy riding and see you on the slopes![/p][p][/p][p]Your Megagons[/p][h1]
PATCH LOG: 02.07.2025 -  v 1.2.100 FREESTYLERS[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Critical: NEW GAME MODE[/b]: Trick Mode is now available as a full solo mode. It unlocks at level 20 and adds a second progression path to the game. It also comes with full leaderboard support and achievements. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical: NEW GAME MODE:[/b] Free Ride Mode has now also been added to the game and unlocks with Level 35. People experienced with Downhill will already know the drill. Free Ride removes all checkpoints and it also uses the Zen version of the trails, allowing for maximum freedom to race down the trails for the best time. It comes with leaderboards and achievements, and full level progression. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Major:[/b] If you are not the biggest multiplayer fan, you can now reach the maximum level in the game by finishing all solo challenges (time trials/tricks/free-ride). [/p][/*][*][p][b]Major:[/b] Added custom button/keyboard mapping[/p][/*][*][p][b]Major:[/b] Added auto-brake and auto-accelerate to the accessibility options[/p][/*][*][p][b]Major:[/b] Added option to now toggle instead of holding accelerate/crouch/break to the accessibility options. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Major:[/b] Added markers to newly unlocked equipment, game modes, gear, trails or slopes. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor:[/b] Added new reward sounds for each trick score threshold.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor: [/b]You can now set which gamepad icons you want to use in the game (Steam only)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Minor:[/b] Reordered the options menu a little bit. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor:[/b] Ghosts are now more transparent when closer to the player. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Improvements & Polishing[/h2][list][*][p][b]Major:[/b] Changed some particle effects to improve performance. It should be especially noticeable on Baifushan. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Major:[/b] improved playing with mouse and keyboard.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Major:[/b] Fixed front or back flips not automatically landing correctly in some situations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.100
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Riders,[/h3]

We hope you’re all doing well, and thank you all for the positive feedback for our newest Baifushan mountain and the supporter pack! We’re really glad you’re all enjoying it and are super grateful for the development support!

Today we have just released another patch for you. Version 1.1.100 comes mainly with a bunch of multiplayer improvements to handle higher latencies better. It doesn’t get rid of all the problems but it should improve a lot of scenarios. 

We also fixed a few problems with the resolution selection and Window mode. Here is the full patch log:

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Minor: [/b]Checkpoint sounds are now part of the “environment” volume category in the settings and so disabling UI sounds will still trigger them.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements & Polishing[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Major: [/b]Criteria for network synchronization are a bit stricter now, which should lead to less drastic corrections in high latency (ping) scenarios.
[*] [b]Major:[/b] Increased local buffer size to handle drastic changes in latency towards the host better.
[*] [b]Minor:[/b] Several small UI fixes and polishing
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Critical:[/b] Fixes rare bug where resolution selection dialog is showing only resolutions in a wrong aspect ratio (PC only).
[*] [b]Major:[/b] Fixed a similar case where in Window mode the window size is reset randomly in fixed intervals.
[*][b] Major:[/b] Fixed several cases where the local player gets teleported back and forth when crashing/respawning in a multiplayer match with high latency.
[*] [b]Major: [/b]Reduced two cases where sideways shifting happened after respawning far away from the checkpoint.
[*] [b]Minor: [/b]Icons and trail names for the Discord activity for the new mountain Baifushan are fixed.
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor: Sideways shifting at the checkpoint still happens when multiple people respawn at a similar time.
[/list]

Have a great time on the slopes!
Your Megagons

notes.title: Roadmap, Patch & Award Nominations
notes.notes:
Hello Riders,

We hope you’re all doing great. We have a bunch of good news for you today!

[h3]Roadmap[/h3]
First, we took some time to develop a roadmap for this year based on your feedback. Please be aware that this doesn’t include everything we are planning, but mainly the things we can commit to and that we can already announce. It might also change over the year based on your feedback and because game development rarely goes as planned. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149182/30cbddfbfc5e488ed06b33d20a1f705564e4560c.jpg[/img]

[b]Spring:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Free Mountain: [/b]On April 9th we will update the game with a new full-fledged mountain. It will come with 4 trails, blue and black slopes as well as new challenges, multiplayer and leaderboard support. We don’t want to spoil the biome yet but we believe it’s the most beautiful mountain we’ve done yet. 
[*] [b]Supporter Pack DLC: [/b]A lot of you reached out and asked if there is a way to further support the development of the game, so we created a nice cosmetics pack that will go live together with the new mountain. Of course, the cosmetics have no gameplay influence but you do get our eternal gratitude for helping us to keep the game alive!
[*] [b]New Trick and Free Ride Challenges and Improved Accessibility Update:[/b] We don’t have a date yet but we will add two new Solo game modes to the game. One new mode that focuses on doing the most awesome tricks and we will also bring back the classic and beloved Free Ride mode from Downhill. More details on the new modes will follow in the future. We will also add a lot more accessibility options to the game like auto acceleration, button/key mapping, etc. 
[/list]
[b]Summer:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]PS5 Version: [/b]We’re working hard on bringing the game to PS5 as well. We don’t have a date yet but we are hopeful that it will happen sometime in summer. 
[*] [b]Multiplayer Update: [/b]We’re trying to bundle together some of the most asked-for multiplayer features into one big update. You will be able to set your private matches public so that they will also be available in the quick match queue, allowing you to play with your friends against or with the community. We also want to improve the tour system, allowing for tours to feature blue and black slopes together and you will be able to vote together on reshuffling the trails. 
[/list]
[b]Autumn:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New DLC Mountain: [/b]We don’t want to spoil anything yet but we plan to release a new DLC mountain later this year. 
[*] [b]Multiplayer Update:[/b] We also plan for another big multiplayer update that mainly features improving the friends and social features in the game along with some bigger changes to the matchmaking system.  
[/list]
[b]Winter and Beyond:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]PC In-Game Editor & Community Maps: [/b]Saving the best for last! We will release an in-game editor for community maps. When we started the development for LMSR one of the first things we did was to create our own editor that runs in the game and we have been using it ourselves to create all the trails in the game. Unfortunately, it will take us the better part of the year to polish it to a point where we can give it to the public and there is also still a whole bunch of things we need to figure out but we hope we can deliver it next winter.  
[/list]

Of course, we are also constantly working on improving the multiplayer, performance and the UI. 

We hope you like our plans. If you have any questions, thoughts, feedback, or ideas the best place for discussions is our [url=https://www.discord.gg/lonelymountains]Discord[/url]. And please remember, just because something is not on the list doesn’t mean it will never happen, it just means that we can’t commit to it or announce it yet. 

[h3]Next Point: Version 1.0.6. [/h3]
We also just released a new version for Steam and Xbox. It’s more of a Hotfix actually and most changes are just in the backend (improved analytics and error reporting) and don’t affect the actual games. 

But for the record, here is the patch log:

[b]20.03.2025 Version 1.0.6. Hotfix[/b]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Minor: [/b]Fixed challenge icons in the trail selection not being updated correctly.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Major:[/b] Improved automatic renderscaler for more stable performance on Xbox S. 
[*] [b]Minor:[/b] Improved the settings layout and added options to choose between performance and quality mode in the startup settings on Xbox.
[/list]
[h3]German Video Game Awards[/h3]
One great news we kept for the end! We are incredibly proud to announce that Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders has been nominated at the [b]German Video Game Awards for Best German Game [/b]alongside the amazing Enshrouded from our friends at Keen Games and Thronefall from Grizzly Games. And we are also nominated for [b]Best Studio[/b] together with Gentle Troll and Aesir Interactive!

This would never have been possible without all of you and the love you all showed for the game!

Thank you all and if you want to hold your breath together with us you can watch the award show live on the 14th of May.

You can check out this page to see all the great nominees! https://deutscher-computerspielpreis.de/nominierte/

That’s it for now and see you on the mountains!
Your Megagons

notes.title: Patch - v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello Riders,

Greetings from sunny Berlin! We hope you’re all doing well!

We just released Version 1.0.5. for Steam and Xbox. 

The most important changes are the new display settings which should also fix a lot of reported performance problems. Display settings don’t get reset anymore, and we added an optional frame rate rate limit to reduce GPU usage, support for variable refresh rates, monitor selection and more. 

There are also a lot of other smaller fixes and changes concerning the multiplayer and the UI in general. Have a look at the full patch log if you want to know more. 


[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed bug that reverted display settings on every restart.
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed a bug that players were stuck on "Initialize Graphics” after the latest patch when they had turned off the imposter generation.
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed various level loading issues that lead to endless loading screens in multiplayer.
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed level not loading when the ghost file got corrupted. We are still unsure how the ghost files get corrupted though and added more logging to better understand the issue in the future.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed automatic mode for render scaling, which always chose the lowest resolution in many cases.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed an issue that the main menu environment scene was sometimes not loaded correctly.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed an issue that broke the spectator mode when another player left the match.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed a bug that sometimes host and clients didn’t load the same level or slope.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed that challenges were not shown as achieved in the endscreen for very close results.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed that sometimes the wrong loading screens were shown.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed Team Mode video explanations not being available in the How To Play screen in the pause menu.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed that environment assets were visually fading in when switching between players in spectator mode or when respawning.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed wrong timings for sound effects for challenges in solo mode.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed that settings page tab buttons were making the wrong sound.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed missing localization for the “Enter Lobby Key” pop-up text field.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed that dropdown options sometimes were hard to select.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed gloss effect being broken for achieved challenges in the trail selection when hovering between different trails.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed that message pop ups for events like host migration would sometimes not appear correctly.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed that times on checkpoint lines and on the endscreen were sometimes not in sync.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed that ready up button was not selected by default after a multiplayer race.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements & Polishing[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Major:[/b] Added support for variable refresh rates on G-SYNC / FreeSync displays.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Added optional frame rate limit to reduce GPU usage.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Previously selected screen settings (resolution, fullscreen mode) are now applied right when starting the game, not at some point while loading the menu.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Simplified display settings to only show quality / performance mode on console.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Added settings option to choose a monitor.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Confirmation dialog is now shown when critical display settings are changed.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Settings options now have explanation texts.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Loading screen now shows the name, mountain and slope you will play next.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] "New best time" display in solo mode when crossing a checkpoint now has a sound effect.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] The end score display for Team Mode now has a "counting up" sound, and a "threshold crossed" sound for bronze, silver, and gold.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] The “AFK timer” and “end of race timer” now have a notification sound.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] The next trail in a tour starting now makes a slightly different sound than before.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Polished the Finish screen layout so that it doesn’t overlap with the “end of race” timer.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Added controller icons for Switch Pro Controller.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] You can now also manually override the controller icons used in the game.
[/list]

We wish you all a great start into the week and as always let us know if you run into any issues, but any feedback is highly apprechated!

All the best,
  your Megagons

notes.title: Patch - v1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello Riders,

We hope you’re all doing well! We just released Version 1.0.4 for Steam and Xbox. 

Again, this patch mainly focuses on the multiplayer stability and fixes a whole ton of endless loading screen and disconnection issues as well as drastically reduced initial loading times. 

We hope we caught most of them now but as you can imagine it is a nightmare to find and reproduce them all. So please continue sending us your logs in case you have any issues. It helps us a lot and we will keep working through all the issues until we squash the last bug. 

Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback on the Quickmatch timer changes introduced in the last patch. Overall the feedback on the mechanic was very positive but most people seem to agree that 60 seconds is a little bit harsh, so we increased the timer to 90 seconds. Please let us know your thoughts if you feel that it now hits a better balance.  

Here are the detailed patch notes for this one:

[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Drastically reduced loading times on first-time start up. 
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed a bug where the menu scene wasn’t loaded when returning from a multiplayer tour.
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed a multitude of bugs that caused an endless loading screen or disconnects from multiplayer matches. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed a bug that allowed players to select locked items. 
[/list]
[h2]Improvements & Polishing[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Major:[/b] Polished navigation behaviour for scroll lists. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fine-tuned UI controls
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Removed minute prefix for timers on checkpoint lines. 
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Major:[/b] Changed racing end timer from 60 seconds to 90 seconds. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] All timers in solo mode now have two decimal points. 
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
We still have an issue that very rarely a client can’t connect to multiplayer games anymore when being forcefully disconnected from a multiplayer match before. The only way to rejoin multiplayer matches at that point is to restart the game. If this happens to you we would be very grateful if you could send us your log file because we have a very hard time reproducing this one.


We wish you all a great time and weekend on the mountains and see you next week for the next patch. 

All the best,
  your Megagons

notes.title: Patch - v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello Riders,

the second big patch is now live on Steam and Xbox. It includes a whole bunch of fixes and improvements but we mostly focused on improving the multiplayer experience! 

First, endless loading screens and problems with logging into a lobby should now happen less often but unfortunately we haven’t been able to get rid of them completely. If you are encountering them, it would be much appreciated if you please let us know and send us your log files. 

Secondly, we are also introducing a major change to the “end of race”-timer in Quickmatches as we got a lot of feedback that it takes too long to wait for players who are still getting a feel for the game. 

From now on in Quickmatch Racing you have 1 minute to finish the trail after the first player crosses the finish line. In Team Mode Quickmatches you have two minutes. Private tours don’t have a timer. If the timer runs out you will be placed on the tour ranking with your current time and rank. 

We know that this is a pretty radical change but in our playtests we really enjoyed the new mechanic. It not only reduces the waiting time a lot and improves the pacing of tours, but it also gives an additional thrill and adrenalin boost to finish the trail in time. Nonetheless, we would be really grateful to get your opinion on it! Please give us your feedback in the forum or on our Discord. 

We are working full force on improving the game further - tackling issues with the resolution rate which causes a lot of performance issues and the section ghost not working on Xbox among other things.

For now, here is the full log of everything that made it into the patch.  

Thanks a lot for being with us on this ride!
 your Megagons


[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Critical:[/b] We fixed multiple different issues that all resulted in an endless loading screen when starting multiplayer tours or trails but sadly it can still happen sometimes. We continue to work on it further. 
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed login issues after suspending the game to the background and coming back to it after a day. This was mostly a problem on Xbox but could theoretically also have happened on PC.
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed a bug that players fell through the terrain when changing or reflection quality settings during a run.
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed various memory leaks which  could lead to a crash (mainly on Xbox).
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed a softlock when having the “Quit Lobby”-pop-up open while the race-end timer runs out. 
[*][b]Critical:[/b] The invite state for lobbies was not updated in all cases. This improves inviting people to your lobby via Discord, Steam Invite and Xbox Invite. 
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed Leaderboard navigation, display discrepancies and page issues. Please mind that your best leaderboard time might not be your best local time if you were not connected to the leaderboards at that time. 
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed trail filter not working in the Result Screen leaderboards. 
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed leaderboards being cut off on certain aspect ratios.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed that the challenge display did not correctly update when hovering with the mouse between blue and black slopes. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed that sometimes the wrong player was displayed after selecting them on the leaderboards.  
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed a UI issue with the team multiplier icon after leaving a resting spot. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed a small visual glitch on the balaclava. 
[/list]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Major:[/b] Added an AFK timer. Players who haven’t crossed the finish line yet and who are inactive during the race for 35s in Quickmatch or 2min in Private Matches will be removed from the tour. 
[*][b]Major:[/b] You can now choose between different color schemes (like a high contrast UI mode) in the accessibility settings. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] We added an offline notification in Solo Mode so you know that your times won’t be transferred to the leaderboards while you’re offline.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements & Polishing[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Major:[/b] Improved loading times and performance of imposter generations (imposters are advanced 2D placeholders for objectsthe low level of detail assets that you can see in the far distance).
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Changing a setting option in a drop down and closing it does not reset the navigation anymore. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Added counting animation when you get new Snowflakes or Exp. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b]Updating the experience bar is now in sync with the result screens. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Polished the emote wheel. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Fixed overlapping threshold line in the Team Result screen.
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Critical:[/b] We made a big change to the end-timer mechanic to drastically reduce wait times during tours. In racing quickmatches you now have 1 minute to finish the race after the first person has crossed the finish line, in team mode it’s 2 minutes. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] We exchanged two of the emote icons. 🤚 “Hold” was replaced with 👏 “Clapping” and 🎉 “Celebrate” was replaced with 😂”Laughing”.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello Riders,

Here's the first bigger patch addressing some critical issues like disconnects when joining QuickMatch lobbies and the visibility of the "Racing End Timer" - but also a lot more. Take a look:

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Sometimes, Quickmatch lobbies were not closed correctly, leaving them in a broken state. Joining players just got a disconnection error. This should fix many of the “Disconnected” situations when trying to join a Quickmatch. 
[*][b]Critical:[/b] The “Racing End Timer” is now displayed correctly when players take too long to finish in quickmatch and is now also used in Quickmatch Team Mode.   
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Fixed black spots appearing around steep sections on Low-quality terrain. 
[*][b]Critical:[/b] The Render Scaler now takes the display refresh rate into account for achievable FPS.
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Team Mode Tutorial videos now work on the Steam Deck.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Navigation between colors now works correctly with the shoulder buttons between hair and beards.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Fixed a rare case where the UI broke when entering spectator camp at the exact moment a run ended.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Parallax snow now works on low-quality terrain (used tessellation before).
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Trick Scores were sometimes not displayed correctly.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Shop Items no longer turn white when leaving the screen. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Removed the “No Crashes” Bonus and “Under 7 Minutes” bonuses from the result screen, as they had been removed before release. 
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Critical:[/b] Improved level design for Sierra Gelida Trail 4. The first big jump is now easier, especially on the black slope. 
[*][b]Major:[/b] Reduced noticeable terrain popping on Low-quality terrain on Steam Deck.
[*][b]Major:[/b] Snow Props now properly check for snow deformation
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Removed visual jittering for the Team Mode Score Display. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Nicer transition when entering Spectator mode. 
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Removed multiplier UI from player names in resting spots.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Various smaller performance improvements.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Snow clouds now fade out when they get too close to the camera.
[*][b]Minor:[/b] Increased water quality for Steam Deck quality settings.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Balancing:[/b] Updated values for some challenges. 
[*][b]Balancing:[/b] Updated EXP and Snowflake distribution for the racing mode. In general, you now get more EXP and Snowflakes, even for lower ranks. This should significantly speed up the progression in multiplayer racing.
[/list]

It's been a crazy week, we received tons of feedback, love and bug reports - keep it coming! We are already working on the next patch, trying to focus on the most important issues and work our way through to give you all the best possible experience. 

The next patch will contain stability fixes for multiplayer sessions and improvements for the end of QuickMatches and a lot more - expect it at some point next week!

- your Megagons

notes.title: Short Behind-The-Scenes Update
notes.notes:
Hello Riders,

We wanted to give you a quick behind-the-scenes update. The last week was amazing and we’re all super happy about all the nice comments and reviews. 

To this moment an unfathomable number of 336.347 riders visited the Lonely Mountains last week, which is absolutely insane. Unfortunately, it was also insane for our leaderboard servers who currently can’t handle the peak times. We’re working hard to improve it and hope we can get rid of the occasional downtimes in the near future. 

We’re also working on a for next week which fixes a whole bunch of things but first and foremost it should make joining quickmatch multiplayer more reliable. 

We are also looking into all the other reports - with multiplayer as a top priority. Please continue letting us know about any issues and please send us your log files, it helps a lot. 

Thank you all for playing the game and for the incredible week!

Your Megagons

notes.title: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders Demo - Multiplayer Patch 3
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

it’s great to see you’re all enjoying the time on the Lonely Mountains! Again, thank you all for your feedback!

We received feedback that it currently takes too long to reach Level 10 in the demo, which is totally understandable considering that you would also like to try out tons of other amazing demos. 

So we just put a patch live that rebalances the progression system. You still need to hit the slopes in multiplayer to reach level 10 to earn the special next fest outfit but it should take considerably less time than before. [b]Please download the newest patch to update your level![/b]

Also, if that wasn’t totally clear, you will get the same experience for tours in private lobbies as for the quickmatch tours, so it’s easy to just grab a few friends to level up. We also set up a whole bunch of new channels in our [url=https://www.discord.gg/lonelymountains]Discord[/url] to find friends and private tours.  

Other fixes for today’s patch include:
Fixed once again that people get stuck at the finish line (this one is a really persistent little bugger)
[list]
[*] Settings now have a button that deletes current best times & ghosts (important for the people who have best times and ghosts from before the Lynx Rebalancing.
[*] There is now a quality preset for the Steam Deck. [b]Please let us know how the performance on the deck is for you with the new preset![/b]
[*] ready display in the "ready for next round" display now always shows the correct number of players
[*] The ready button in the Next Screen should now always show the correct state
[*] Fixed a bug that you ended up in a non-respawnable crash state when you were crashed while a host migration happened.  
[*] Fixed once again that the end timer in racing mode shouldn't stay on screen anymore
[*] Waiting time in the quick match lobby doesn’t get reset when a player leaves the lobby
[/list]

If you want to know what’s waiting for you at the end of level 10 here is a little teaser.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149182/b428968bcb4f2b8c026f230166090feb5f054bdc.jpg[/img]


All the best and have a great weekend on the Lonely Mountains. And as always, it would mean a lot to us if you wishlist and leave a review for the demo as this weekend is super important for the game. 

Your Megagons!

notes.title: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders Demo - Multiplayer Patch 1
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Riders,[/h2]

We finally managed to set the new patch live. Thank you all for your patience! We are hopeful that future patches will go more smoothly.

You need to update the demo now to play multiplayer! (Sometimes you have to restart Steam for an update to actually work)

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] We implemented a new end-timer. So in case a player won’t finish the race or will take too long while everyone else has already crossed the finish line a timer will set in and end the race if the person doesn’t finish in time.
[*] We shortened all waiting times (time until a tour starts, time between trails, time between tours).
[*] Leaderboard Navigation will work with mouse controls again.
[*] We fixed that sometimes network messages (like new host, host disconnected, etc) would stay on the screen until you restarted the game. 
[*] We improved the rubberbanding / weird movements that sometimes happen when you respawn at a checkpoint in multiplayer.
[*] We fixed the problem where the timer showing when the next tour starts wasn’t always visible and also redesigned it. 
[*] We made the last jump on Trail 2 Hard Slope a little bit easier.
[*] In the future, you will be informed in-game if you need to update your version for multiplayer. 
[/list]

Let us please know if you experience any issues with the new build.

As you might know, Steam now allows you to leave a review for a demo. If you like the game it would really mean the world to us if you leave us a positive review. The Next Fest is super crowded this time and it would help us a lot to get some more visibility for the game!

Thank you all and see you on the mountains,
Your Megagons

notes.title: Patch Announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Riders,[/h2]

First, thank you all for your feedback! We are more than happy to see that you all enjoy the new multiplayer mode! We spent a lot of time on it over the last 4 years, so it’s great that we can finally play together with all of you!
 
But, who would have guessed, it turns out that making multiplayer games is hard and comes with its own set of problems. One of them is that we just can’t update the game without throwing everyone out of the multiplayer - as a new patch forces you to update the game. 

As many people are playing now and we don’t have feedback for a new available update in the game we decided to postpone today’s patch to tomorrow. 

[b]So the patch will go live tomorrow around noon (MEST) and it will throw you out of the multiplayer if you’re playing at that moment. You can continue playing after you download the update. [/b]
 
[b]Tomorrow's patch will include:[/b]
[list]
[*] We implemented a new end-timer. So in case a player won’t finish the race or will take too long while everyone else has already crossed the finish line a timer will set in and end the race if the person doesn’t finish in time.
[*] We shortened all waiting times (time until a tour starts, time between trails, time between tours).
[*] Leaderboard Navigation will work with mouse controls again.
[*] We fixed that sometimes network messages (like new host, host disconnected, etc) would stay on the screen until you restarted the game. 
[*] We improved the rubberbanding / weird movements that sometimes happen when you respawn at a checkpoint in multiplayer.
[*] We fixed that sometimes the timer that shows you when the next tour is going to start wasn’t visible.
[*] We made the last jump on Trail 2 Hard Slope a little bit easier.
[/list]

We also want to take this moment and thank everyone who helped us test the demo before the Next Fest. And especially want to celebrate the crazy speedruns that people did with the over-the-top Lynx version. So here are the Top 10 on both slopes for the Pre-Demo. There will also be a little in-game memorial for them but more on that when the game will be released. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149182/b2e30155158a3a282706513f8488dc6651117276.png[/img]

We wish you all a lot of fun on the Lonely Mountains! Please keep your feedback coming. It’s highly appreciated. 

All the best,
Your Megagons
